text: Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, the API returned HTTP 502 errors for 12% of requests. A deploy removed the cache warmup step from the deploy process. The missing step caused the errors. Automated monitoring detected the errors at 14:04 UTC. The team reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. The API returned to normal operation at 14:31 UTC. The incident lasted 29 minutes. Users must retry any failed requests from that period. The team will add a check for the cache warmup step to the deploy process. This check will prevent the same problem in the future.
